text_block_list.text:
I signed a contract with Hokko Tarumae and
spent days 
training for a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Instantaneous power,
startup and stamina enhancement…… 
Yes, it is indeed what I need now.
choice_data_list: Train hard and we will win!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir! I'm off!
And a few days later―

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
―Started.
Hokko Tarumae off to a good start from the
inside!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha, ha!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Good positioning. As per training…… 
now anyway, keep it here!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
（I'm going to win…… and I'm going to be the
kind of person 
that Tomakomai can be proud of!)

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What? Is this restaurant going to close too?
I love the 
Hokki rice set meal……

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Shopping D...
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know.
I'm sorry for Tarumae and the 
other regulars,
but we haven't had many customers 
lately. It's time to move on.

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Such is the case with…… Hey,
hey! If we get more customers, 
the store, won't close!

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is Hokko Tarumae!
Do you know the most delicious "Hokki 
rice special" in Tomakomai?

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanted to let you all know about 
the taste of the food,
so after the concert, 
I decided to do a special food report…

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Shopping D...
text_block_list.text:
Well…… I can't believe you're really
getting 
more customers. Thanks, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness!
I guess that settles the matter, huh?

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I've had a hokki
rice set meal, and 
I'm looking forward to it. ―What? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The store…… is gone……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Local reconstruction is difficult.
Even if you can boost it 
temporarily,
the wave of people soon recedes…)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(It takes knowledge, effort,
and passion to keep going. But 
that still doesn't absolutely stop the
decline ……!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae 3, 4th― off the lead 200,
2 lengths, 3 lengths away!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(But… But that doesn't mean I want to give
up ……!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Even if things don't go well at all,
even 
if I'm constantly reminded of it every
day―I won't be weak anymore,
I'm not going to lost!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I'll be the one to make Tomakomai…… Tomakomai
Shine!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae coming up to second! 
Hokko Tarumae approaching!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Tell them aaaaaa―!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae, caught! Goal in!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha, ha, ha……! ……!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ―I'm Hokko Tarumae from Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai is warm and full of charm……! 
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The one she's talking about…… Tomakomai? 
Where is it? Do you know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I may have heard of it.
I think it's a town 
in Hokkaido isn't it? Let's check ……

Next day. 
Hokko Tarumae visited me in the trainer's
office.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry! Looking back,
I think that I forced you to 
sign a contract with me on the spur of the
moment……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
But thanks to you waking me up, 
I know exactly what I need to do……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was able to focus on the feeling that I
was going to win 
the race and…… So, you know―

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling that…… with you I would
make a good locodol. 
And…… you like haskaps too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Well, so,
I mean! What I'm doing here is…

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: …… It's a bit late but.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
I am Hokko Tarumae.
I look forward to working 
with you from now on.

I hurriedly stood up and took it with both
hands. The 
business card she offered me showed a majestic
volcano, Mount Tarumae,
with white smoke rising from its peak.
